title: Buttons

focus_mode.label: Focus mode
focus_mode.description: Show only the grid and necessary pagination. Ctrl+E temporarily toggles edit mode.

name: Name
command_help: Runs with /bin/sh -c in the host environment. Use absolute paths when needed. Save does not execute the command.
layout_help: Rows × columns sets the number of buttons per page. Extra items appear on later pages. The drawer keeps its fixed size.
edit_help: Click to edit. Right-click two cards to swap them; right-click the selected card to cancel.
invalid_item: Name and command are required. Check field limits in the README.
item_limit: The drawer supports up to 200 items.
launch_failed: The command could not be started.
storage_unavailable: Cannot access plugin storage. Reopen the drawer to retry.
invalid_storage: Unsupported or damaged items.json. The file has been preserved. Repair it and reopen the drawer.
storage_changed: Storage changed elsewhere. Reopen the drawer before saving again.
storage_too_large: Cannot encode the data, or it exceeds the 256 KiB storage limit.
save_failed: Could not save. Your draft is retained; check storage access and retry.
state_help: Click to run and read stdout: 0 or 1, optionally followed by an icon name (e.g. 1 moon). State commands keep the drawer open; timeout is 10 seconds. The default is used on plugin reload.
status_failed: State command failed or returned invalid output. Expected: 0 or 1, optionally followed by an icon name.
swap_help: Right-click another card to swap; right-click the selected card again to cancel. You can change pages.
